items.subject: When a family at Bible Way Missionary Baptist needs help

args.subject: When a family at Bible Way Missionary Baptist needs help
args.body:
Hello Bible Way Missionary Baptist team,

I'm Harshit, the founder of CouponDonation.

When a family at Bible Way Missionary Baptist is in need of food, groceries, travel or health benefits, the people around them usually want to help and don't know how. We give them a way.

The family, or someone at the church for them, starts a free page. People give from $10. Each gift reaches the family as a store gift card, never cash, and the giver is told when it's received and used.

We're a company, not a charity, so gifts aren't tax-deductible. We take no fee from the gift. 100% goes to the families.

If a family comes to mind, or asks you for help, this is the page to pass on:
https://www.coupondonation.com/apply

Questions? Just reply.

Harshit Agrawal
Founder, CouponDonation

--
CouponDonation Inc., 300 Creek View Road, Suite 209, Newark, DE 19711
You're receiving this because Bible Way Missionary Baptist's email is on its public listing.
Reply "no thanks" or "unsubscribe" and I won't write again. You can also write to unsubscribe@outreach.coupondonation.com.

items.subject: When a family at Sonrise Church needs help

args.subject: When a family at Sonrise Church needs help
args.body:
Hello Sonrise Church team,

I'm Harshit, the founder of CouponDonation.

When a family at Sonrise Church is in need of food, groceries, travel or health benefits, the people around them usually want to help and don't know how. We give them a way.

The family, or someone at the church for them, starts a free page. People give from $10. Each gift reaches the family as a store gift card, never cash, and the giver is told when it's received and used.

We're a company, not a charity, so gifts aren't tax-deductible. We take no fee from the gift. 100% goes to the families.

If a family comes to mind, or asks you for help, this is the page to pass on:
https://www.coupondonation.com/apply

Questions? Just reply.

Harshit Agrawal
Founder, CouponDonation
